name: bash-with-stderr
description: A bash tool whose lowered payload carries a non-empty stderr maps to a ToolEvent that CARRIES both streams and is deliberately NOT hinted command_failed — stderr is not a failure signal (see the Claude Code adapter for the measurement). OpenCode's live `tool.execute.after` exposes a single combined output string, so today's shell lowers stdout only; the mapper's two-stream contract is proven here.
